title: Incidents, notifications and learning
summary: Whether incidents are reported, investigated and learned from, and whether CQC is told about notifiable events without delay.
whenToUse: Every quarter, after a serious incident, or when incidents or late notifications rise.

statements.focus: Incident reporting, investigations, root causes and lessons shared with staff.
Statutory notifications to CQC: every notifiable event sent, on time, with a record kept.
Safeguarding concerns referred to the local authority and followed through.
Trends in incidents reviewed and actions finished.
Working with the local authority, police and health partners after incidents.
